text:
Type: braided money tree houseplant
Use: indoor greenery by a window, in a bright corner or next to a sofa; living room, home office, dining room
Style: bohemian, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: living plant with a braided trunk, glossy hand-shaped leaves, brown plastic grower pot
Colors: fresh green, tan trunk, terracotta brown pot
Shape: several thin trunks braided into one stem topped by a rounded crown of leaves, tall and upright, slender and light
Feel: lively, fresh, natural, calming
Goes with: woven baskets, ceramic or rattan plant pots, light wood, white walls; bohemian, Scandinavian or Japandi rooms
